name: dayprint
description: Analyse what your AI tools know about your work, locally and with consent, and get a Cavion workspace plan: a branded report with workflows, quick wins and time saved, plus a setup file Cavion can apply.

interface.shortDescription: Find the work that repeats and plan your Cavion workspace
interface.longDescription: Reads your ChatGPT, Claude and Codex history, memory, documents, calendar and connected apps on your computer, with consent per source, removes personal data, and produces a report and a workspace setup file.
defaultPrompt: Use Dayprint to analyse my work and plan my Cavion workspace.
